head: working-tree
subject: RDS URI-template path matching and rewriting
change: RouteMatch.path_match_policy (field 15) and RouteAction.path_rewrite_policy (field 41) now decode their TypedExtensionConfig/Any envelopes and use the URI-template engine. The match policy compiles the bounded template and captures named variables while matching the path with query and fragment removed; the rewrite policy substitutes those variables into the owned request path. Rewrites without a template match policy, unknown extension type URLs and rewrite placeholders not declared by the match template fail validation.

unit: src/grpc/xds/routing/template_tests.zig covers the URI-template engine, including the Envoy documentation examples and malformed templates.

src/grpc/xds/rds/tests.zig 'gRPC RDS applies URI template path rewrites' decodes path_match_policy and path_rewrite_policy, asserts the route uses a path template, selects /cat/dog, and verifies the rewritten path /dog/cat through call.PathRewrite.write.

notes: Non-router HTTP filters and broader control-plane orchestration remain open.
